channel.title: Evangelical Times Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Evangelical Times Limited (evangelical-times.org)

item.title: Single-sex spaces code of practice will not apply to workplaces, equalities minister says
item.description: Long-awaited guidance from the government about protecting single-sex spaces will not apply to workplaces, the government’s equalities minister has said.

item.title: Peers speak out against plans to decriminalise abortion up to birth
item.description: The House of Lords has been debating an amendment which would decriminalise women who abort their babies, even up to the point of birth.

item.title: Will bombs bring freedom for Iran’s Christians?
item.description: Will bombing Iran bring liberty for Christians, or will it only deepen persecution?

item.title: But Now I See
item.description: This book is not designed or intended to be a detailed verse-by-verse commentary, but rather a chapter-by-chapter guide through the Gospel of John. The author focuses upon the main thrust of this majestic Gospel, causing us to see the Lord Jesus Christ afresh for who he is.

item.title: Brazil: student faces jail for social media posts on gender
item.description: A Brazilian woman is facing criminal prosecution and the potential for a 10-year stretch in jail after posting comments on social media expressing her views on gender ideology.

item.title: No, the Church of England hasn’t abandoned plans for same-sex blessing ceremonies
item.description: The Church of England’s ongoing debate over prayers for same-sex couples reached a fresh juncture last month as General Synod debated procedural changes to its Living in Love and Faith (LLF) programme.

item.title: The Carey Conference celebrates the supremacy of God’s Word from Tyndale to today
item.description: 500 years ago, William Tyndale’s landmark English New Testament was printed. In celebration of this, the Carey Conference in January focused on ‘the perfection and power of the Word of God’.

item.title: The importance of Dr Lloyd-Jones’s exposition of the Sermon on the Mount
item.description: As you look out across the nation, or further throughout the West, or even into the whole world, what would you say was the great need of the times?

item.title: New Perspective on Paul revisited: A primer and warning
item.description: A movement called the ‘New Perspective on Paul’ (NPP) first began quietly reshaping how evangelicals understood the gospel back in the 1970s.

item.title: Australia: Lack of care pushes Queensland man to assisted suicide
item.description: Motor Neurone Disease Australia, a charity supporting people with the disease and their families, has highlighted one man’s appeal to start the voluntary assisted dying process.
